cues.text: Chidori kneels beside Junpei, lying still.
Behind her, a ghostly Persona rises. Her glowing hand rests on his bloody chest.
The team watches in silence. Fuuka clasps her hands.
Golden sparks drift around Chidori. Yukari, Mitsuru and Ken look on.
Chidori has fallen into his arms. Junpei holds her as the team gathers close.
Her head rests on his chest.
Chidori lies limp in his arms. Junpei bows his head. A tear falls.
A thin crescent moon hangs in the green sky.
